Standard: The pitch controller force required to maintain the trim conditions for at least 5 seconds following the initiation of a configuration change does not exceed the Level 2 limits as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Pitch Trim Changes paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the pitch control forces to maintain the trim condition after a configuration change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Pitch Trim Changes paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the pitch control forces to maintain the trim condition after a configuration change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Pitch Trim Changes paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight to assess the pitch control forces to maintain the trim condition after a configuration change as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Pitch Trim Changes paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
